headline: Nigerian Naira Strengthens as Foreign Exchange Turnover Jumps
summary: The naira appreciated against the US dollar at Nigeria's official foreign exchange market as FX turnover increased significantly.
why: Foreign exchange turnover and exchange rate movements are vital for assessing liquidity and macroeconomic stability in emerging markets.

impacts.name: USD/NGN
impacts.why: Higher FX turnover and improved liquidity strengthened the naira against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An increase in foreign exchange turnover boosted the local currency's valuation.
